'''Masara''' was a large island continent northwest of [[Thyr]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Description==
A vast island continent, Masara's northwestern shore stretched along the [[Thyrian Ocean]], which separated the continent from Thyr by eight hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. On the southern coast a [[Tho Yor]] had touched down in [[36,453 BBY]], and a community of pilgrims formed around it. Eventually the Temple of Arts, [[Bodhi]], was built around the Tho Yor, near an estuary between the sea and the primordial [[Edge Forest]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
